answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 16 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 660 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The meadow test is the live device, the ripple test is the locked stake, and the spiral test is the graded history no template can fake.
